eyebrow: NoSQL, Document & Graph Databases · Chapter Eleven
subtitle: Lesson 60 · Querying with Cypher

code:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:WORKS_AT]->(c:Company)
WHERE c.name = 'Northwind Traders'
  AND p.hireYear >= 2020
RETURN p.name, p.hireYear
ORDER BY p.hireYear DESC
LIMIT 5
caption: Same jobs as T-SQL's WHERE, ORDER BY, and TOP.

code:
MATCH (c:Company)<-[:WORKS_AT]-(p:Person)
RETURN c.name,
       count(p) AS employeeCount,
       avg(p.salary) AS avgSalary,
       collect(p.name) AS employeeNames
caption: collect() gathers values into a list — idiomatic in Cypher's document-shaped results.
